title: 同舟行
englishTitle: A Song of the Shared Boat

lines.zh: 春申黄渡初来客，繁李萦堤波心澈。
lines.en: A newcomer to Huangdu, in the land of Chunshen; plum blossoms wind along the banks, and the water’s heart is clear.

lines.zh: 才辞杨浦何处去，忽闻龙吟同舟河。
lines.en: Just leaving Yangpu, I wondered where to go—then heard a dragon’s cry upon the Tongzhou River.

lines.zh: 战鼓轰天催浪彻，长呼裂岸挟潮过。
lines.en: War drums thunder through the waves; long cries split the banks and ride the tide.

lines.zh: 百桨齐开翻碎玉，一舟推水入烟波。
lines.en: A hundred paddles scatter jade-white spray; one boat drives into the misty water.

lines.zh: 少闻家翁争龙舸，千页翻残端午歌。
lines.en: As a child I heard of elders racing dragon boats, and wore through pages singing of the Dragon Boat Festival.

lines.zh: 学长笑言舟健骨，学姐称师堪作爹。
lines.en: The older boys laughed: rowing makes strong bones; the older girls praised the coach as dear as a father.

lines.zh: 乍见龙威动心魄，口牙一震试操戈。
lines.en: The dragon’s force first shook my heart; with a startled shout, I longed to try the oar.

lines.zh: 命轮暗转龙舟课，水引浮生入此歌。
lines.en: Fate quietly turned toward a dragon-boat class; the water drew my drifting life into this song.

lines.zh: 初逢于师身正直，虎背丰神气若戈。
lines.en: I first met Coach Yu, upright and broad-backed, his bearing bright and sharp as a spear.

lines.zh: 问舵偏时何处打，随答舵向即舟挪。
lines.en: Asked where to turn the rudder when we drifted, I answered: where it points, the boat will go.

lines.zh: 一语偶中天机破，懵然被点掌长舸。
lines.en: One lucky answer unlocked the secret; bewildered, I was chosen to steer the long boat.

lines.zh: 初试人舵心未和，左冲右荡满舱波。
lines.en: At first my hands and rudder shared no understanding; we lurched from side to side, the hull awash.

lines.zh: 旋从舵后归舱坐，方知划水真快活。
lines.en: Then I left the stern and took a paddler’s seat, discovering how joyful rowing could be.

lines.zh: 细柳拂堤伴云过，游鱼逐桨影相和。
lines.en: Slender willows brushed the banks beneath passing clouds; fish followed the shadows of our paddles.

lines.zh: 一船一息催潮起，群龙并浪竞如梭。
lines.en: One boat, one breath, lifting the tide; dragons raced abreast like flying shuttles.

lines.zh: 嘉园试棹初成阵，教头笑劝莫蹉跎。
lines.en: At Jiayuan our first formation took shape; the coach smiled and urged me not to waste the chance.

lines.zh: 初入龙社试此身，十六里奔百引磨。
lines.en: I first tested myself among the dragon crew: an eight-kilometre run, a hundred pull-ups to grind me down.

lines.zh: 气断臂软身欲折，举目群肩犹未歇。
lines.en: Breath gone, arms weak, my body near breaking; I looked up—every shoulder beside me still worked.

lines.zh: 愈痛愈醒心淬铁，愈疲愈奋血犹热。
lines.en: The greater the pain, the clearer the mind, tempered into iron; the greater the weariness, the hotter the blood.

lines.zh: 水势千钧横作阙，欲摧洪浪骨作戈。
lines.en: The weight of water rose before us like a fortress; to break the flood, our bones must become spears.

lines.zh: 束衣整桨临堤岸，潮男潮女相形色。
lines.en: Clothes straightened, paddles ready by the bank—a vivid company, each with a style their own.

lines.zh: 黄毛诡笑惊新客，姝队谈笑暖春泽。
lines.en: A yellow-haired grin startled the newcomers; the women’s captain warmed our talk like spring.

lines.zh: 首棹旁观睥四座，灵舵一旋弧影过。
lines.en: The stroke paddler’s gaze surveyed the gathering; a deft turn at the stern traced an arc upon the water.

lines.zh: 右舷言寡力满舱，摇滚长发逐舟波。
lines.en: Few words on the starboard side, but strength enough to fill the hull; a rocker’s long hair followed the waves.

lines.zh: 百斤却作千钧魄，四平艇手上龙舸。
lines.en: A slight frame held a mighty spirit; a rower from Siping came aboard the dragon boat.

lines.zh: 侦查兵王双门阔，肌肉型男自巍峨。
lines.en: The veteran scout stood broad across the shoulders; the muscular young man rose like a mountain.

lines.zh: 德王牌运压群豪，研辈无言气已迫。
lines.en: The poker king’s luck outplayed the crowd; the graduate veterans commanded respect without a word.

lines.zh: 火影少年承使命，烟酒小生亦挥戈。
lines.en: The Naruto-loving youth shouldered his mission; the young smoker and drinker took up his paddle too.

lines.zh: 闽粤双锋争领桨，西陲关外不让多。
lines.en: Two strong paddlers from Fujian and Guangdong vied to lead; those from the far west and northeast gave no ground.

lines.zh: 劲姊气盛人唤哥，歌王一吼众声和。
lines.en: A spirited sister earned the name of “brother”; the singer’s shout brought every voice into accord.

lines.zh: 闽舵百战弧犹稳，幻衣摇曳影婆娑。
lines.en: The Fujian helmsman held his arc through a hundred contests; a cosplayer’s changing clothes danced through the scene.

lines.zh: 催命长桨十二圈，一桨一桨到力竭。
lines.en: Twelve punishing laps with the long paddle—stroke after stroke until no strength remained.

lines.zh: 眼前白浪皆如雾，身外浮生渐不觉。
lines.en: The white waves blurred like mist before my eyes; the world beyond my body slipped away.

lines.zh: 忽尔长呼破寒雪，满船推我向前越。
lines.en: Then a long cry broke through the cold; the whole boat seemed to push me onward.

lines.zh: 我亦振声血复热，水引群心向终阙。
lines.en: I raised my voice, my blood grew warm again; the water drew our joined hearts toward the finish.

lines.zh: 初征肥西丰祥湖，五百长程试壮图。
lines.en: Our first expedition: Fengxiang Lake in Feixi, where five hundred metres tested our ambition.

lines.zh: 前宵结伴寻烧烤，举杯初识笑言殊。
lines.en: The night before, we wandered out for barbecue; over raised cups, new voices became familiar.

lines.zh: 烟火摊前同坐久，杯盘夜半话江湖。
lines.en: We lingered in the smoke and glow of roadside stalls, talking half the night of life beyond the water.

lines.zh: 明朝列阵胸中鼓，枪响群龙竞一呼。
lines.en: Next morning we lined up, drums within our chests; the starting shot sent every dragon surging with one cry.

lines.zh: 力尽还随群桨落，千声如浪托身浮。
lines.en: Strength spent, I still dropped my paddle with the rest; a thousand voices buoyed me like the waves.

lines.zh: 始知差距隔深谷，归来暗誓再追逐。
lines.en: Only then did I see the gulf between us and the best; home again, I quietly vowed to close it.

lines.zh: 铁人相约攀高杠，百引争多臂不休。
lines.en: Training partners gathered at the high bar, competing through a hundred pull-ups, arms refusing rest.

lines.zh: 小二夜话灯昏处，吃喝玩乐尽风流。
lines.en: Late conversations in the dim upstairs canteen—food, drink, games, and all the pleasures of our youth.

lines.zh: 身随舟律舒筋骨，清波暗度入心湖。
lines.en: My body loosened into the boat’s rhythm; clear ripples quietly entered the lake within my heart.

lines.zh: 桨桨倾身驱颓腐，半卷青春系此途。
lines.en: I leaned into each stroke to drive despondency away; half my youth became bound to this course.

lines.zh: 四海同舟归一户，始见天地为龙舒。
lines.en: From every corner we came to share one home; through the dragon boat, the world began to open.

lines.zh: 授桨铭名登战谱，愿携长楫共沉浮。
lines.en: Paddles bestowed, our names entered on the roster; with these long oars, we pledged to weather rise and fall together.

lines.zh: 苏州河畔天初朗，急水奔流势未央。
lines.en: Morning cleared above Suzhou Creek; the swift current ran with undiminished force.

lines.zh: 鼓手擂声催战响，舵借海洋尾波狂。
lines.en: The drummer beat us into battle; the helmsman rode the fierce wake of the Maritime crew.

lines.zh: 头桨稳拍收百势，动力齐推万里浪。
lines.en: The stroke paddlers gathered every impulse into rhythm; the power seats drove us through wave after wave.

lines.zh: 眼前忽作空明境，身随呐喊共悠扬。
lines.en: Suddenly the world became clear and empty; my body rose and fell with all our shouts.

lines.zh: 全船凝作一潮涨，老将摘银泪满眶。
lines.en: The whole boat gathered into a single rising tide; silver won, the veterans’ eyes brimmed with tears.

lines.zh: 末岁龙舟添后生，来去无常一舸横。
lines.en: In my final year, new faces joined the dragon boat; people came and went, while one hull waited on the water.

lines.zh: 昔日萌新今作老，方知身水两相忘。
lines.en: Yesterday’s novice had become a veteran; only then did I understand how body and water forget their boundaries.

lines.zh: 泰苏两役连折戟，银浪余辉尚梦萦。
lines.en: Two defeats at Taizhou and Suzhou broke our charge; the afterglow of silver still haunted our dreams.

lines.zh: 新老围杯歌未竟，前程隔雾正难明。
lines.en: Old and new hands shared their cups, the song unfinished; ahead, the future lay hidden in mist.

lines.zh: 人推舟行舟载人，我去此舟赴何程？
lines.en: People propel the boat, and the boat carries people; when I leave it, toward what journey do I go?

lines.zh: 收箱束箧别黉堂，远赴中山作终章。
lines.en: I packed my belongings and said farewell to school; far away in Zhongshan, we would write the final chapter.

lines.zh: 风雨倾江浑不挡，一身尽与水茫茫。
lines.en: Rain poured into the river, and we let it come; my whole body belonged to the boundless water.

lines.zh: 初来客梦安曾想，别绪偏随珠水长。
lines.en: How could that newcomer’s dream have foretold this? Parting stretched as long as the Pearl River.

lines.zh: 弃履抛镜轻尘障，只余人桨赴终航。
lines.en: Shoes cast off, glasses set aside, small encumbrances gone—only bodies and paddles for the final voyage.

lines.zh: 夹岸人潮声震荡，神凝长楫劈涛狂。
lines.en: Crowds thundered on both banks; our minds fixed on the long oars cleaving the wild waves.

lines.zh: 鼓化龙头凌雨上，舵成龙尾定洪荒。
lines.en: The drum became the dragon’s head, rising through rain; the rudder its tail, steadying the tumult.

lines.zh: 百桨入江身化浪，人随珠水作流光。
lines.en: A hundred paddles entered the river, our bodies became waves; we flowed with the Pearl in streaks of light.

lines.zh: 忽见长龙蹈江起，忘我凌空向远翔。
lines.en: Suddenly a long dragon seemed to leap from the river; forgetting ourselves, we soared toward the distance.

lines.zh: 一线冲开天地旷，前江不见别舟航。
lines.en: Across one line, the world opened wide; no other boat sailed on the river ahead.

lines.zh: 力尽犹擎长桨起，云开日出照天光。
lines.en: Strength exhausted, we still raised our long paddles; clouds parted, and sunlight filled the sky.

lines.zh: 莫辞更尽乌苏酒，旧事千端待细详。
lines.en: Do not refuse another Wusu beer; a thousand old stories still await their telling.

lines.zh: 因舟一遇成知己，天涯万里亦同堂。
lines.en: One meeting aboard a boat made us trusted friends; ten thousand miles apart, we still share a home.

lines.zh: 他年若问同济事，便说同舟这一章。
lines.en: If someone asks, in years to come, about Tongji—tell them this chapter of our voyage together.

notes: The source credits the dragon boat team, Class of 2026. Numerical references to accompanying team recollections are omitted from this reading edition; the poem’s wording is preserved.

title: 阉人吟

lines.zh: 二段失陨，若千丈入冰，终期尽失，鸿鹄退已。
lines.en: Twice brought low, as though falling a thousand fathoms into ice; every hope undone, the soaring swan retreats.

lines.zh: 八百里秋沙落胡洲，九万里长空寂无人。
lines.en: Autumn sand settles across eight hundred li of distant shoals; ninety thousand li of sky lie empty and still.

lines.zh: 华山巍峨亭雀难立，孤林萧肃斥鴳何安？
lines.en: Mount Hua towers too high for sparrows to perch; in the desolate grove, where can the little quail find peace?

lines.zh: 空荡荡乎久不振，噫！
lines.en: Hollow and listless, so long unable to rise—alas!

lines.zh: 慢甸甸兮来者追，远。
lines.en: I drag my steps as those behind draw closer, then far ahead.

lines.zh: 自悉不就何去何从？
lines.en: Knowing I have come to nothing, where am I to go?

lines.zh: 蒙蒙离雾阴蔽孰离。
lines.en: Parting’s murky mist shrouds the way—who can escape it?

lines.zh: 历久长庚未见晓曙，看尽夕红不了阳炎。
lines.en: Long watching the evening star, I have seen no dawn; through all the sunset’s red, I have not grasped the sun’s fierce heat.

lines.zh: 愧己劳徒泯然湮灭，憾其倨守莫期徊旋。
lines.en: Ashamed that all my toil dissolved into obscurity; regretful that stubborn pride left no hope of turning back.

lines.zh: 凤翔涅槃余鹄归散，鹏适南溟凡鸟销还。
lines.en: The phoenix rises through rebirth, the remaining swans disperse; the great Peng flies south, and common birds fade homeward.

lines.zh: 浩宇芒星非冀吾摘，良辰晓梦毋眷王骸。
lines.en: I do not ask to pluck the stars from the vast sky; let bright hours and dawn’s dreams linger no longer over a fallen king.

lines.zh: 华胥不存冬风酒醒，南柯未竟遍地阑干。
lines.en: The realm of Huaxu is gone; winter wind sobers the wine. The dream of Nanke unfinished, tears lie scattered everywhere.

lines.zh: 悲摧苦恨繁霜烧尽，寥落难忍再罹他寒。
lines.en: Grief and bitter regret burn through the heavy frost; desolation, hard to bear, meets yet another cold.

lines.zh: 孤寒怎怨庭柯错落？
lines.en: How can my loneliness blame the branches tangled in the courtyard?

lines.zh: 孑穷不惜旁道伤残！
lines.en: Alone and destitute, I heed no wounds along the byways!

lines.zh: 吾既销损复立遗风，渡鸟又征孰滞其才？
lines.en: Though worn away, I rise to carry what remains; when migrant birds set out again, who can hold their gifts in check?

lines.zh: 沉眠久矣今道兀炯，蔓蔓长枝将不畏裁！
lines.en: Long have I slept; now the path shines clear—the stretching branches shall no longer fear the shears!

lines.zh: 左支右绌马失前蹄，庸人自扰不以为然。
lines.en: Caught short on every side, my horse stumbled; I dismissed it as a fool’s needless worry.

lines.zh: 倏尔消疏堤溃千里，蓦然回首余碎尽燔。
lines.en: Suddenly all came apart, like a breached embankment; looking back, I found even the fragments burned.

lines.zh: 踌躇满志风声鹤唳，胡卢乱语怎生酸寒？
lines.en: Full of ambition, yet frightened by wind and cranes—how did my careless laughter turn so bitter and cold?

lines.zh: 奉若圭臬不辩明是，受辛未及却误狂嗔。
lines.en: I took a rule as sacred without asking whether it was true; before enduring hardship, I mistook wild anger for my answer.

lines.zh: 忧愤未尽痛失前期，立心悔教谨此长吟。
lines.en: Anxiety and anger linger; the time I hoped for is lost. I resolve to learn from regret, and set it down in this long song.

notes: A figurative lament of lost ambition and renewed resolve. Huaxu and Nanke evoke dream-worlds; the great Peng and the small quail recall contrasting scales of aspiration. The final stanza is the source’s 补叙 (Afterword).

title: 霸王别姬
englishTitle: The Hegemon Bids Farewell to His Beloved

lines.zh: 飞蹄踏尸过，后尘升复平。
lines.en: Flying hooves pass over the fallen; behind them dust rises, then settles.

lines.zh: 千兵逐十骑，刀剑不绝音。
lines.en: A thousand soldiers pursue ten riders; swords and sabres never cease to ring.

lines.zh: 英雄终欲落，神勇万世名。
lines.en: The hero must at last fall, his valour named through countless ages.

lines.zh: 纵天下灭我，亦战死不屈。
lines.en: Though all beneath heaven destroy me, I shall die fighting, never yield.

lines.zh: 汉王春部兵，意欲东伐楚。
lines.en: In spring the King of Han assembled troops, intending to march east against Chu.

lines.zh: 凡五十六万，尽西蜀强兵。
lines.en: Five hundred and sixty thousand, all strong soldiers from the west of Shu.

lines.zh: 项羽自携卒，旨在天下征。
lines.en: Xiang Yu led his own men, bent on conquering the realm.

lines.zh: 率忠士三万，破汉军十馀。
lines.en: With thirty thousand loyal soldiers, he broke a Han host many times their number.

lines.zh: 数占城池下，屡败刘邦去。
lines.en: City after city fell; again and again Liu Bang was driven back.

lines.zh: 震彭城十颤，扬沙石千里。
lines.en: Pengcheng shook beneath the blows; sand and stones flew for a thousand li.

lines.zh: 周苛烹荥阳，彭越走东阿。
lines.en: Zhou Ke was boiled at Xingyang; Peng Yue fled toward Dong’e.

lines.zh: 辗转八方战，军疲罢转漕。
lines.en: Fighting in every direction, the army wearied and the grain convoys faltered.

lines.zh: “今天下匈匈，惟吾二人争。
lines.en: “The world is in turmoil because the two of us contend.

lines.zh: 何无一战毕，免苦世间民！”
lines.en: Why not end it in a single fight, and spare the people’s suffering!”

lines.zh: 项王竖矛立，嗔目挑战起。
lines.en: The King of Xiang stood with spear upright, glaring as he issued his challenge.

lines.zh: 汉王以推辞，勉强差人应。
lines.en: The King of Han declined, reluctantly sending another to reply.

lines.zh: 鸿沟与汉约，中分天下地。
lines.en: At Honggou they made their pact, dividing the lands beneath heaven.

lines.zh: 楚军东归去，汉兵趁危袭。
lines.en: Chu’s army withdrew eastward; Han struck while it was vulnerable.

lines.zh: 时运惜不济，功业致相反。
lines.en: Alas, fortune failed him, and achievement turned upon itself.

lines.zh: 精卒难耗久，长驻遇断粮。
lines.en: Even chosen troops cannot endure forever; a long encampment brought an end to grain.

lines.zh: 垓下壁残兵，数重围诸侯。
lines.en: At Gaixia the remnant army held its walls, surrounded by the lords on every side.

lines.zh: 虞姬正思量，四面楚歌声。
lines.en: Lady Yu sat in thought as songs of Chu rose all around.

lines.zh: “夕阳兮夕阳，冥思而怀想。
lines.en: “Setting sun, O setting sun—deep in thought, I dwell on memory.

lines.zh: 路遥兮路遥，征将恋旧乡。”
lines.en: Long road, O long road—the campaigning general yearns for home.”

lines.zh: 项王邀军饮，共叙当年勇。
lines.en: The King of Xiang invited his men to drink and speak of their former courage.

lines.zh: 姬知业将近，浅吟替君唱。
lines.en: She knew his enterprise was nearing its end, and softly sang for him.

lines.zh: “楚地兮霸王，自志征天下。
lines.en: “Hegemon of Chu, you set your heart on conquering the world.

lines.zh: 孤傲兮将军，独身赴战场。
lines.en: Proud and solitary general, you went alone into the field.

lines.zh: 众人兮相悖，坑秦卒余万。
lines.en: You turned against the multitude and buried Qin’s soldiers by the myriad.

lines.zh: 立君兮不善，弑义帝江中。
lines.en: You dealt ill with the ruler you had raised, slaying the Righteous Emperor upon the river.

lines.zh: 力以拔山兮，进势无人挡。
lines.en: Your strength could uproot mountains; none could halt your advance.

lines.zh: 气以盖世兮，豪迈孰者当。
lines.en: Your spirit overshadowed the age—who could rival such boldness?

lines.zh: 何料兮食尽，疲乏力难酬。
lines.en: Who foresaw the grain exhausted, your weary strength unable to answer?

lines.zh: 何料兮兵绝，困苦破难为。
lines.en: Who foresaw the army spent, the siege too hard to break?

lines.zh: 惟愿兮不周，尚功业未成。
lines.en: Only the wish remains unfulfilled, the great work still undone.

lines.zh: 惟志兮不尽，留天下未征。”
lines.en: Only the will remains unspent, with the world still unconquered.”

lines.zh: 项王置尊笑，挺起将士中。
lines.en: The King of Xiang set down his cup and smiled, rising among his soldiers.

lines.zh: 恨慨不思量，抚膺骤长叹。
lines.en: Regret beyond reckoning seized him; he pressed his chest and heaved a long sigh.

lines.zh: “奈何兮齐天，欲亡我此时。
lines.en: “Why does heaven above seek to end me at this hour?

lines.zh: 奈何兮虞姬，终吝与成全！”
lines.en: Why, Lady Yu, does it still begrudge us fulfilment!”

lines.zh: 美人与泣下，悲苦意已决。
lines.en: The beauty wept beside him, her resolve made firm in sorrow.

lines.zh: 众人莫能仰，相与抒哀情。
lines.en: None could lift their eyes; together they gave voice to grief.

lines.zh: 已而时益近，遗刃上马骑。
lines.en: As the hour drew closer, he left a blade behind and mounted his horse.

lines.zh: 率壮士十余，骋敌军百里。
lines.en: Leading a dozen brave men, he rode a hundred li through the enemy.

lines.zh: “此天妒霸王，非战之罪也！”
lines.en: “Heaven envies the Hegemon; this is no failure in battle!”

lines.zh: 任长矛高举，径驾马冲敌。
lines.en: His long spear raised, he drove his horse straight into the foe.

lines.zh: 飞蹄踏尸过，刀剑不绝音。
lines.en: Flying hooves passed over the fallen; swords and sabres never ceased to ring.

lines.zh: 斩将碎前道，刈旗临乌江。
lines.en: He cut down commanders, broke a path, and felled their banners on the way to the Wu River.

lines.zh: 亭长檥船待，霸王拒渡江。
lines.en: The ferryman waited with his boat; the Hegemon refused to cross.

lines.zh: “此世义已尽，何复以相劳！”
lines.en: “My duty in this life is done—why trouble you again!”

lines.zh: 虞姬执残刃，静默素自刎。
lines.en: Lady Yu took the remaining blade and silently cut her throat.

lines.zh: 项羽露尖刀，哗天弑霸王。
lines.en: Xiang Yu bared his sharp sword; in an outcry to heaven, the Hegemon ended his life.

notes: A poetic retelling of Xiang Yu and Lady Yu. The translation follows the poem’s own sequence and imagery, rather than recasting it as a historical account.
